raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary Fixes [vllm-project/vllm#63467](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/63467): Rust tokenizer split-cache wrong token ids by bumping `fastokens` to **0.3.4** and adapting the Decoder API. Claimed on the issue (cc @waynehacking8 @BugenZhao). ## Changes - `rust/Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock`: pin `fastokens` to **0.3.4** - `hf.rs` `is_byte_level_only`: handle 0.3 `Fuse` + other new Decoder variants (`_` → non-byte-level) - `new_fastokens`: `set_truncation(None)` + `set_padding(None)` so we keep main’s prior non-truncating behavior (variant 2 under “Fixing it”) - Tests: `new_fastokens_clears_configured_truncation`, `fastokens_split_cache_append_matches_fresh_encode` ## Verification ``` cargo test -p vllm-tokenizer --lib # 99 passed ``` ## Not in this patch - Python `fastokens>=` floor (blocked on crusoecloud/fastokens#85) - Folding into #51027 (coordinated with @waynehacking8 / @BugenZhao on the issue) Signed-off-by: bantianyue Fixes #63467 --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
